content.intro: In this lesson, you will work through introduction to jquery plugins with a focused jQuery example. The subtopics below preserve the supplied curriculum coverage and connect the API idea to a small browser interface.
content.why_it_matters: This topic is useful because it turns what a plugin is into a repeatable implementation choice. A jQuery plugin usually extends $.fn, acts on every element in the collection, and returns the collection for chainability. Stateful plugins need deliberate defaults, instance storage, and teardown.
